into account parameters such as language. This allows you to create a database of users for subsequent actions, such as sending mailings, inviting users to groups, or promoting products. It effectively helps configure interaction with the target audience, boosting marketing campaign results. The module in Telegram Expert collects only visible chat participants. If chat members are hidden, use the «Collection of people who wrote to the chat» module. The module does not allow collecting participants who are hidden. Settings options: Use database You can connect a database if you have previously collected participants from a list of chats. Connect the existing database, and Telegram Expert will continue the collection if it was interrupted earlier. The software resumes gathering the audience from links in the database where the collection could not be completed previously. Moreover, the program can recollect an audience based on the database, which is useful when you want to cover new chat subscribers over time to keep the database updated. If there is no database, you need to specify a list of groups on the right side: there is a special field where group usernames or links are entered as a list, with each entry on a new line. Remember that Telegram Expert collects the audience from one link per task for one account. Therefore, if you specify 10 links for one task, you need to select 10 accounts to complete the task. Time limit The time limit in this case considers when users were last online. If you set the value to 30, the final database will include users who were active within the last 30 days, as well as those whose last visit time is hidden due to privacy settings. To collect the most comprehensive audience, you can specify the value as 9999. Maximum timeout (FloodWait) Here, you set the time the software will wait if an account encounters a flood restriction. If the restriction time exceeds the specified value, the account's work stops. If the time is less, the software will continue the task after waiting. Select accounts Choose the accounts from which you will collect the audience. Remember, one account collects users from only one link per task. Accounts can only be selected from the «Active» folder. Audience language Users are collected based on their names in the specified language. For example, if users' names are in Russian, the software will collect them, provided the «Russian-speaking users» option is enabled. Leave groups when done After collecting the audience, the account that joined the group for parsing will leave it. This is convenient when you don’t want to accumulate unnecessary group subscriptions. Exclude administrators Excludes administrators or moderators of the chat from which the audience is being collected. They will not be included in the final database. Create .txt files with usernames All collected usernames are automatically saved to a file, which can be used for inviting users, for example. The file contains usernames copied from the final database. Streams control Specify how many accounts will work simultaneously. If you select 100 accounts and set 10 threads, the software will take the first 10 accounts and start using them. Once an account finishes its task, the next account is used, continuing this process until all accounts are done. This means 10 accounts will work simultaneously, rotating with the delay you specify (a random value within the set range).
